_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 979 and 1148, y 300), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (602,880). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

overlap.reason: Enemy cavalry (uid9) on the default 5v5 compresses below the cavalry overlap floor during the live charge this clip exists to show. Pre-existing on main; owned by #1398 (melee) / #1401 (spacing), not this spawn-pin retarget.
